profile.headline: Electrical/computer engineer with interests in innovative human-computer interfaces and assistive devices.
profile.summary: Skilled in Java, Matlab, C/C++, and Embedded Systems. Strong professional with a Bachelor of Science (BS) focused in Electrical and Computer Engineering with a minor in biotechnology/bioengineering from Lafayette College.

positions.title: Software and Embedded Systems Engineer
positions.description: Contributed to support tools for machine learning development in Python using TensorFlow, JAX, and Streamlit. Developed an application for direct video feed using C++ on an embedded system Linux platform. Created a web Application Programming Interface (API) for retrieving filtered information from a database using Python and FastAPI.

positions.title: Technical Solutions Engineer
positions.description: Assisted customer support staff to customize the Epic software suite and troubleshoot complex issues. Guided implementation of new features. Participated in internal projects to improve automated metric collection tools.

positions.title: Contractor
positions.description: Developed and tested flight display software using model-based design techniques for an aircraft system as part of a large team using an Agile development process, scripted unit testing, and code versioning tools. Participated in regular increment and sprint planning sessions.

positions.title: Student Researcher
positions.description: Examined Java code from prior research in using a wireless neuro headset as part of a brain-computer interface to control a quadcopter drone.  Adapted this previously written Java code to control the same programmable robot from my Summer 2014 work with the brain-computer interface mentioned.

positions.title: Student Researcher
positions.description: Utilized example code to interface an eye tracking device with MATLAB.  Wrote and tested code to command a programmable robot through MATLAB using the eye-tracker.  Experimented to create a functioning user interface for controlling the robot with the eye-tracker.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: Administered manual system error-checking.  Tested database information processing.

courses.name: Analysis and Design of Solid State Circuits

honors.title: Finley W. & Ethelwyne H. Smith Electronic Engineering Prize
Walter B. Morton Contest, First Place
honors.description: Awarded for the paper Wheelchair Navigation Using a Brain-Computer Interface

projects.title: Starfinder Character Manager
projects.description:
An application for managing character information for use with the Starfinder RPG system by Paizo. 
Created using C++ and Qt.

projects.title: Tabletop Gaming Encounter Manager
projects.description: An application for managing combat encounters for tabletop role playing games. Designed using C++ and Qt.
